review_reference: Owner decision of 2026-11-03 (D-Eminence): the demo patients' profiles must reach 100%; Adaeze (HID-ZDEMAAA2) and Chinedu (HID-ZDEMAAA3) get the phone and NIN with clearly fictional values the real NIN service can never match, through a reviewed seal change following the 0102 pattern.
evidence: 0119 (sealed demo profiles complete), owner decision of 2026-11-03 by D-Eminence: the demo patients' profiles must reach 100%; unsigned until the owner signs. Backward compatible: no table, column, index, constraint, policy or trigger changes. It adds two functions in schema identity, owned by the applier: identity.demo_profile_phone_allowed(text,uuid,text,character) (SECURITY DEFINER, EXECUTE for hid_identity_runtime and hid_schema_test_runtime only) and identity.demo_profile_install() (SECURITY DEFINER, granted to no role), both revoked from PUBLIC in the file and in runtime-grants.sql. It replaces one body, 0098's G5 identity.patient_contact_changes_sealed_demo() (CREATE OR REPLACE; trigger, owner, ACL, SECURITY DEFINER, search_path and error code kept), after an md5 precondition on its exact 0098 text and on every body it relies on. WHAT CHANGES. A sealed demo patient's phone change is still refused (22023) unless Identity asked the new check in the same transaction and it admitted that patient's own fictional number (Adaeze +447700900102, Chinedu +447700900103, the UK drama range) with the change's HMAC, and refuses those two numbers to every real patient, so they stay the demo's (0094's patients_phone_hmac_uq would otherwise let a real patient who took one first leave the demo patient no number it may hold); a refused number answers 400 CONTACT_INVALID with the detail 'This phone number cannot be used on this account. A demo account can use only its own demo number.'; an Identity image that never asks it (every image before this release) still has every demo phone refused, so old images keep working for every real patient. On Amazon RDS only (rds_superuser present, as 0098 and 0102) the seed gives Adaeze and Chinedu a verified nin identifier through a resolved registration case at Demo Hospital, provider and source hid-sealed-demo, with no NIN stored (a lookup value that is not an HMAC under Identity's key, a plain-text marker, hint ****0000); assurance stays CONTACT_VERIFIED; no verification_evidence, authoritative profile, nin_hash or QoreID quota row; G6 unchanged. The seed refuses with 55000 and nothing applied when the demo is not as 0098 and 0102 left it (SEALED_DEMO_PROFILE_NOT_DEMO, _PATIENT_NOT_READY, _ROLE_MISSING, _ID_TAKEN); a patient who already has a NIN identifier is skipped. The same identity-api image leaves the seed's two resolved cases (provider hid-sealed-demo at a sealed demo facility) out of the platform admin's Identity review list and its total (GET /api/v1/admin/identity/reviews); any other case at a demo facility is still listed with demo: true, and an older image lists the two marked demo: true. It does not require the photo or an emergency contact (the owner adds them in the app); the owner runs the header's read-only query before signing. The release alone does not bring the card to 100%: after it the owner types the two numbers (country United Kingdom, 07700 900102 and 07700 900103), adds a photo and an email emergency contact where 0102 left none, and then runs the header's read-only post-deploy query, which must answer true in every column for both patients (phone with its matching completed change row, photo, emergency_contact, nin, gender_dob_state, hospital_hmo, blood_genotype); the suite runs the same query. ORDER: 0119 before the identity-api image whose PatientContactChangeService.changePhone asks identity.demo_profile_phone_allowed (an image that asks it before 0119 exists fails every phone change); after both, the owner types the two numbers on the demo profile pages. Numbers 0104-0118 belong to other unreleased work and are not on this branch; 0119 uses none of their objects, and the ledger and components entries must be re-based when they land; RELEASE BLOCKER: the release contract's contiguous-prefix check fails on this branch until then: node --test release/test/staging-migration-ledger.test.mjs answers 1 pass and 1 fail (verifyMachineConfiguration: 'components config.migration.files: missing migration prefix', release/scripts/verify-release-contract.mjs), so CI and the release pipeline are red for 0119 until 0104-0118 are merged and components.json, the ledger map and that test are re-based; if 0119 must ship first, the coordinator gives it the next free number (0104). PROOF on throwaway PostgreSQL 16 (private cluster, synthetic data only), rerun after the review fixes: upgrade of a 0001-0103 database by the runner as a NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS migrator (plan 1 pending, dry run rolled back, apply, then 0 pending, and the file run again answers 0119: already applied); fresh install of all 105 files as that migrator; the same upgrade and fresh install with a superuser owner; every database suite (77 and the new sealed-demo-profile suite) green on the superuser-owned fresh and upgraded databases (78 of 78 each), and 76 of 78 on the NOSUPERUSER-owned ones, where schema and ocr-worker-lease fail identically on the 0103 baseline without 0119; the new suite cases (a real patient refused both demo numbers with nothing recorded or written; the post-deploy query true in every column for both patients) fail against the earlier check body and pass with this one. Earlier on this file before the review fixes (the seed is unchanged by them): the staging schema upgrade rehearsal passed (baseline 104, integrated 105, declared 0119); with the role rds_superuser present on a 0103 database in the demo state 0098 and 0102 leave, the runner applied 0119 and seeded 2 cases, 2 identifiers and 5 audit rows, and on the same state with Adaeze inactive it refused SEALED_DEMO_PROFILE_PATIENT_NOT_READY with nothing applied; 7 of 7 mutants killed. identity-api typecheck and jest (1863 tests); scripts/verify-migration-ledger.mjs passes; release/test/staging-migration-ledger.test.mjs FAILS (1 pass, 1 fail, 'missing migration prefix') until 0104-0118 land, as stated above.
